model_weights_license: CC-BY-4.0 for the mounted AlphaFold2 2022-12-06 parameters; the provisioned params LICENSE file is CC BY 4.0
python_requires: 3.12 for the pinned Linux CUDA profile
notes: v1.0.7 adds Apple Silicon support and Linux install/check helpers; it is not docs-only. The runner uses the upstream-tested Linux CUDA 12.9 pip profile (Python 3.12, jax[cuda12] 0.11.2, openmm 8.6.1, colabdesign 8fd167de) and the PyRosetta-free runtime mode: `--no-pyrosetta` selects OpenMM relaxation with PDBFixer preparation and open-source scoring (FASPR side-chain packing, FreeSASA/Biopython SASA, sc-rs shape complementarity) instead of PyRosetta FastRelax. Upstream validated that profile on an RTX 5090; it does not establish fit for other production GPUs.
